# Tendai Mudyiwa

> Tendai Mudyiwa is a product manager, engineer, and writer working where technology, music, creativity, and business meet. Product manager at TicketSwap since 2025, focused on helping event organisers in live events. Previously a backend engineer for four years, starting at Morgan Stanley in New York. Studied mathematics and computer science. Has lived and worked in Zimbabwe, the US, Hong Kong, and the Netherlands.

Available for talks, panels, and podcasts on music, technology, and live events, and for writing on the same topics. Contact: hello@tendaimudyiwa.com
